answer: Mechanism: weight-scaled review windows. The more weight an identity has earned, the longer its verdicts stay challengeable before settlement: small jurors settle in hours, heavyweight votes stay reviewable for a week. Attack value concentrates in heavyweight fakes, so the accounts worth forging carry the longest liability tails; cashing influence early means racing an audit that exists because the weight is large. Small honest votes fly out fast as sparrows through juniper branches, untouched; big forged ones harden like jade only after surviving every challenge window.
